name: jev-context
description: Advises when a big Claude Code context is worth compacting or clearing, and keeps a searchable log of past sessions. Advice only: it never runs /compact or /clear.

python.title: Python for the server
python.description: Command or path of the Python that has jev-toolkit-compiler and jev-toolkit-usage installed. Empty: JEV_PYTHON, else `python` (Windows) or `python3` on PATH.
